parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, made of plastic, typically cylindrical and hollow to fit over the pen tip. It measures approximately 5 cm in length and 1.2 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip from drying out and prevents ink leakage. It may also clip onto a pocket or notebook for portability.
parts.Movement_description: The cap can be removed or attached by pulling or snapping it onto the pen body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic, cylindrical in shape, approximately 14 cm long and 1.2 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: The base body houses the ink reservoir and provides the main gripping area for writing. It connects to the pen tip and may hold the cap when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary during use, but it can be held and rotated by the user for comfortable writing.
